responseText:
root = Stack([revenueChartCard, selectClientCard, clientDetailsCard])

$selectedClientId = null

clients = Query("host_listClients", {}, [
  {id: "clt1", businessName: "Acme Corp", entityType: "C-Corp", contactName: "John Doe", contactEmail: "john@acme.com", assigneeId: "asg1", filingDeadline: "2023-10-31", progress: {received: 5, total: 10}, status: "pending", assignee: {id: "asg1", name: "Alice", role: "Manager", initials: "AD"}, revenue: 150000},
  {id: "clt2", businessName: "Beta LLC", entityType: "LLC", contactName: "Jane Smith", contactEmail: "jane@beta.com", assigneeId: "asg2", filingDeadline: "2023-11-15", progress: {received: 8, total: 8}, status: "complete", assignee: {id: "asg2", name: "Bob", role: "Associate", initials: "BJ"}, revenue: 200000},
  {id: "clt3", businessName: "Gamma Inc", entityType: "S-Corp", contactName: "Peter Jones", contactEmail: "peter@gamma.com", assigneeId: "asg1", filingDeadline: "2024-01-31", progress: {received: 2, total: 7}, status: "pending", assignee: {id: "asg1", name: "Alice", role: "Manager", initials: "AD"}, revenue: 80000},
  {id: "clt4", businessName: "Delta Partners", entityType: "Partnership", contactName: "Sarah Lee", contactEmail: "sarah@delta.com", assigneeId: "asg3", filingDeadline: "2023-09-30", progress: {received: 10, total: 10}, status: "complete", assignee: {id: "asg3", name: "Charlie", role: "Junior", initials: "CE"}, revenue: 120000},
  {id: "clt5", businessName: "Epsilon Solutions", entityType: "Sole Prop", contactName: "Mike Green", contactEmail: "mike@epsilon.com", assigneeId: "asg2", filingDeadline: "2024-02-28", progress: {received: 3, total: 5}, status: "pending", assignee: {id: "asg2", name: "Bob", role: "Associate", initials: "BJ"}, revenue: 60000}
])

selectedClient = Query("host_getClient", {id: $selectedClientId}, {"id":"","businessName":"","entityType":"","contactName":"","contactEmail":"","assigneeId":"","filingDeadline":"","progress":{"received":0,"total":0},"status":"","assignee":{"id":"","name":"","role":"","initials":""}})

revenueChartCard = Card([
  CardHeader("Revenue by Client", "Simulated data"),
  HorizontalBarChart(clients.businessName, [
    Series("Revenue", clients.revenue)
  ], "grouped", "Revenue (USD)")
])

selectClientCard = Card([
  FormControl("Select Client to Drill Down",
    Select("selectClient", @Each(clients, "client", SelectItem(client.id, client.businessName)), "Select a client...", null, $selectedClientId)
  )
])

clientDetailsCard = $selectedClientId != null && selectedClient.id != "" ? Card([
  CardHeader("Details for " + selectedClient.businessName, "Filing Deadline: " + selectedClient.filingDeadline),
  TextContent("Contact: " + selectedClient.contactName + " (" + selectedClient.contactEmail + ")"),
  TextContent("Entity Type: " + selectedClient.entityType),
  TextContent("Assigned To: " + selectedClient.assignee.name + " (" + selectedClient.assignee.role + ")"),
  TextContent("Progress: " + selectedClient.progress.received + " / " + selectedClient.progress.total + " documents received"),
  TextContent("Status: " + selectedClient.status)
]) : null
